name: tinyframe
desc: Minimalistic library for reading and writing the Frame Streams protocol
why: Frame Streams is a DNS-OARC protocol most people never meet, and this is a door into its framing layer.

brief.what_it_is: tinyframe is a small C library, from the DNS-OARC project on Codeberg, for reading and writing the Frame Streams protocol. Frame Streams is a binary framing layer that wraps a sequence of data payloads in a four-byte header per frame, so a program can tell where each message starts and ends on a byte stream. The library takes byte payloads in and produces framed byte streams out, or parses framed streams back into payloads. The README says nothing about the API, data types, or example usage.
brief.why_it_exists: The README gives only one framing sentence: "tinyframe is a minimalistic library for reading and writing the Frame Streams protocol." It does not state a motivation. The Frame Streams protocol it links to is described by its upstream project as a transport for arbitrarily encoded payloads, used for data in motion over sockets and for data at rest in files.
brief.how_it_works: The README does not explain the internals. The upstream Frame Streams description says each data frame carries only four bytes of framing overhead, and a Content Type header identifies the payload type for a stream. Whether tinyframe implements the full control-frame handshake or only the data-frame layer is not stated in what I read.
brief.install_notes: The README has no install or build instructions. The repository file listing shows autotools files (configure.ac, autogen.sh, Makefile.am, m4/ directory), and the language split is C 60.5%, M4 34.9%, Makefile 3%, Shell 1.6%. That suggests a standard ./autogen.sh && ./configure && make build from a git checkout, but I did not confirm this from documentation. The repo also has debian/ and rpm/ packaging directories. The brew formula was given with no executables, so this is a library, not a command-line tool.
brief.standout: It is a deliberately tiny, single-purpose C library for one specific framing protocol, which is an unusual niche. The Frame Streams protocol behind it comes from DNS-OARC's dnstap logging world, where it is used as a high-speed binary log transport for DNS servers.
brief.status: Appears maintained. The Codeberg page shows the latest commit fd54d46b8b, "Merge pull request 'Release 0.1.2' (#53)", dated 2026-10-16. It lists 92 commits, 3 tags, and 3 releases, and the release-related commits are dated within the last few days of the page snapshot. The project also has SonarCloud badges, and the repo has SECURITY.md and CONTRIBUTING.md files. I did not check the date against today's date, so treat the timestamps as the page's own claim.
brief.caveats: The README is one sentence and has no usage docs, so the API has to be read from source or headers. The Codeberg page requires JavaScript to render, so I worked from the server-rendered text. The page also shows a notice about Codeberg's terms changes, which is not relevant to the library. I did not find a license statement in the README. The repo contains COPYING and COPYING.LESSER files, which suggests LGPL, but I did not verify the license from the README or the file contents. The brew description and the homepage are consistent. The repo has only 0 stars and 1 watcher, so adoption looks small.
quotes: tinyframe is a minimalistic library for reading and writing the Frame Streams protocol.
